evidence: Timestamps are created inside extraction, reports and ZIP metadata.
consequence: Same canonical input cannot be rebuilt byte-for-byte; diffs and provenance become noisy.
remediation: Inject a clock/build metadata object, canonicalize serialization, and add reproducibility tests.

evidence: Documentation says schema-validated, but only TypeScript interfaces exist.
consequence: Invalid or migrated manifests can silently reach renderers.
remediation: Add JSON Schemas, runtime validation, schema versions and migrations.

evidence: The core type is one AgentManifest.
consequence: The app cannot characterize multiple agents, assign responsibilities or express dependencies.
remediation: Introduce NetworkManifest, AgentNode and graph validation.

evidence: No TaskNode or HandoffContract exists.
consequence: Task distribution and agent coordination are absent.
remediation: Add task decomposition, ownership, dependencies, handoffs and cycle checks.

evidence: Adapters are hard-coded and not versioned; Claude imports are literal; Windsurf path is stale relative to current docs.
consequence: Generated files can look plausible but not load as intended.
remediation: Create versioned adapter registry, official-source metadata and fixture tests.

evidence: Runtime files list paths in backticks rather than using client-specific inclusion syntax.
consequence: Secondary rules may never enter model context.
remediation: Compile client-specific imports/inlining and verify with fixtures.

evidence: Checks use blueprint references instead of parsed rendered content; metadata omits some rendered references.
consequence: Missing links can pass and harmless omissions can fail.
remediation: Parse Markdown/frontmatter and validate actual links/imports.

evidence: User-derived text is inserted into Markdown and a fenced system-prompt block without robust escaping.
consequence: Malformed files or instruction-boundary injection are possible.
remediation: Add untrusted-field encoding, fence escaping, AST render and adversarial fixtures.

evidence: No tests, test script, lint, typecheck script or workflow exists.
consequence: Core correctness and regressions are unproven.
remediation: Add unit, property, integration, ZIP round-trip, adapter and E2E tests plus CI.

gap: Release gate does not fail closed
evidence: A penalty score can be high while runtime behavior remains UNVERIFIED; download remains available.
consequence: Users can mistake internal consistency for production readiness.
remediation: Separate quality score from release decision and block artifacts on mandatory gate failures.

evidence: Stage labels advance by timers; compilation occurs once at the end.
consequence: UI communicates work that has not yet happened.
remediation: Use real synchronous stage events or remove artificial processing claims.

evidence: Inputs, outputs, quality bars and workflows mostly come from domain templates.
consequence: Generated agents may not match the user's stated acceptance criteria.
remediation: Add structured extracted fields, provenance pointers and confirmation/edit step.

evidence: saveText keeps only the basename.
consequence: Cursor/Copilot/Windsurf files can be installed in the wrong location.
remediation: Download folder-preserving bundles or display exact placement instructions.

gap: No persistence, import, diff or rollback
evidence: State exists only in the current React session.
consequence: Projects cannot be sustainably maintained or regenerated.
remediation: Add IndexedDB workspace storage, manifest import/export, version history and diffs.

evidence: EVALUATION.md contains manual UNVERIFIED cases.
consequence: There is no repeatable acceptance evidence.
remediation: Add executable fixture runner and stored results.

gap: Guardrails are not compiled to enforcement
evidence: Tool permissions remain prose.
consequence: The runtime may ignore constraints.
remediation: Generate supported permission/hook configs and mark unsupported enforcement explicitly.

evidence: No verified date or source map is stored.
consequence: Compatibility and model availability age silently.
remediation: Move catalog to data with source, verified date, capability flags and deprecation policy.

evidence: No SBOM, license scan, secret scan, checksums or signed release process.
consequence: Production distribution lacks integrity and dependency evidence.
remediation: Add release scripts, SBOM/license/secret checks and checksum manifest.

evidence: Source has useful accessibility elements but no browser/E2E evidence.
consequence: Keyboard, screen-reader and responsive defects may remain.
remediation: Add Playwright flows and automated accessibility checks.

evidence: Current official documentation can change without detection.
consequence: Adapters can regress after vendor changes.
remediation: Add scheduled source review and compatibility contract tests.

evidence: Provider/model selection is metadata only.
consequence: Complex briefs cannot be semantically normalized beyond regex heuristics.
remediation: Add an optional, sandboxed extractor interface while keeping deterministic core and manual fallback.

evidence: No root README, deployment guide, ADRs, support bundle or release runbook.
consequence: Maintenance and handoff are fragile.
remediation: Create production documentation and architecture decision records.
